Telangana Gig Workers Postpone Strike After Government Talks

Gig workers in Telangana announced an indefinite strike scheduled to begin on August 8. Following discussions with the Telangana government, the strike has been deferred by 10 days. Unions clarified that the strike is postponed, not withdrawn. The government held an emergency meeting in anticipation of the industrial action. Hyderabad airport had advised passengers to plan ahead due to potential disruptions.
